App details

Meal Planner — „Mit főzzek?”

Find ideas for what to cook, use ingredients and leftovers, and plan your week.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Reduce the daily effort of deciding what to cook. Get up to three recipe suggestions based on your choices or ingredients at home, or use a separate option for prepared leftovers. Plan one recipe per day for seven days, keep the days you like and change others. The recipe selection and ingredient recognition are still being checked.

Main features

  • Up to three suitable recipe suggestions.
  • Separate options for ingredients and prepared leftovers.
  • Seven-day plan with one chosen recipe per day.
  • Own recipes, preferences and a combined shopping list.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Daily suggestions, leftovers and the weekly plan

What should I make today?

Choose your preferences and optional time, category or meal-use filters to get up to three matching recipes. If only one or two qualify, only those appear; with none, adjust choices yourself. Favorites, family tastes, available ingredients and recent meals help rank valid choices. Suggestions can include uncooked food, desserts, sauces or drinks, not just main dishes.

The ingredients you have

Enter or select even a few ingredients, including part-used packages; a complete pantry is unnecessary. See up to three recipes with usable/missing-ingredient status and a concrete missing list. Select servings to see required quantities; you decide whether your actual stock is enough. Missing ingredients can be added individually or together to shopping.

Use prepared leftovers separately

Enter a cooked dish/component, optional quantity and notes in the separate leftover mode. It offers up to three recipes only when an established compatible use exists; raw rice and cooked rice are not interchangeable. Accept the proposed use explicitly, see relevant steps and avoid allocating the same amount twice. Unknown matches prompt clarification, not an invented reuse recipe; edibility is not certified.

Seven days, one recipe per day

Build a seven-day plan with one general recipe slot each day. Lock accepted days and replace one day without changing the other six. Choose portions; ingredient reuse and variety help planning. Any supported category may fill the slot; no suitable recipe leaves it explained and empty rather than fabricating one. It is not a full breakfast/lunch/dinner daily diet.

Cuisine, categories and saved preferences

Choose a country/region and local-only or international cuisine selection separately from app language. Allow only the cuisines you want; favorites, disliked/excluded foods and allowing new dishes shape suggestions. Filter available validated categories, meal use, preparation time or vegetarian/vegan labels. Recipe/category selection is still being checked; allergen filtering is not included.

Your recipes, portions, cooking history and ratings

Create or edit your own recipe with ingredients, quantities, portions and steps; pictures are optional. Scale known amounts to a chosen number of servings, keeping taste-based or unknown quantities clearly marked. Use only established ingredient substitutions you accept. Mark I cooked it to record the occasion, add 1–5 stars and notes, and keep favorites. These local ratings are not public reviews.

Three kinds of local recognition

Camera ingredient recognition proposes possible unlabelled ingredients; text recognition reads packaging names/sizes; barcode scanning reuses local associations. Review, correct or remove suggestions and confirm before adding ingredients. Manual entry works when recognition fails. The recognised ingredient list/model is still being validated; prepared-food recognition is not offered as automatic leftover identification.

Combined shopping list

Merge compatible ingredients from the plan and selected recipes; subtract confirmed home quantities or accepted leftover allocations only once. Unknown quantities remain items to check, not zero. Add manual entries and tick bought items. Changing one plan day updates the list while preserving other days and locked choices.

Free manual use and one-time Premium

All four main modes, manual ingredient/leftover entry, recipe filters and weekly planning are free. Camera recognition has a shared limit of three starts in any rolling 24 hours across image, text and barcode methods; cancellation before capture does not count, but a failed captured attempt does. One-time Premium removes banners and this camera limit; it is not a subscription and Play supplies the current price.

Offline data, content updates and backup

Use your own and installed recipes, lists and plans offline without a required account or ReadyStock. Validated recipe updates keep personal favorites, ratings and history. Create an offline backup of recipes, ingredients, leftovers, plans/locks, shopping and notes, then review before restore. Purchase access is restored separately; missing recipe content is identified, not fabricated. Built-in recipes and recognition coverage are still being prepared and checked.

An About portrait surprise

Tap the About logo seven times for the planned offline portrait scene of JN86VI’s wife and chief cook. Close the stylised portrait to return; recipes, plans and personal data stay unchanged.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
